note: Example data: an invented online booking software company with invented accounts, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input. The site, its sitemap and every API response behind this run are invented.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "indexing-monitor" skill. Check which of my pages Google and Bing have indexed, tell me why the rest aren't, and say what to submit.
new_pages_source: the user's answer to the new-pages question: 6 pages published since 9 October, with their publish dates
must_index_pages: none given (the top-pages check covers the 20 pages with the most impressions)
connections: google-search-console and bing-webmaster, both Read & Write
data_pulled: live sitemap (195 URLs, one file, every URL with a lastmod)
batch_url_inspection on 34 sitemap URLs (6 new pages, then 28 with no impressions), in 4 batches of up to 10
status-code-checker on 5 not-indexed URLs and 12 URLs with impressions that are not in the sitemap
get_feeds, get_crawl_stats (181 daily rows), get_crawl_issues, get_url_submission_quota (bing-webmaster)
